indices: g=0..G-1; local h=0..Hg-1; s=0..S-1; rows ordered stratum then local history; columns shared paired seed
population_rng: none; integer-index deterministic additive plus interaction fixture
actual_input_bytes: not_generated_preparation_only; write and hash before each authorized API call, then independently reread/hash/shape-check saved artifacts in supervisor
bootstrap_rng: production crossed-v1 numpy.PCG64.multinomial; fixed software-only seeds 1900..1905, not scientific population streams

algorithm.cap_unmet: retained endpoint outcome; not an operational error; continue remaining declared cases unless an actual error/budget violation occurs

budget_scope: single supervised worker; global timer includes worker startup/preflight/imports/input creation/all six calls/serialization/final supervisor validation; parent release administration before worker launch is separately excluded
memory_scope: worker Darwin ru_maxrss delta from pre-numerical-import baseline plus supervisor ru_maxrss delta from pre-worker baseline; live worker RSS sampled by supervisor; polling has scheduler/measurement latency, violations preserve observed overshoot and stop
worker_environment: only PATH=/usr/bin:/bin, LC_ALL=C, LANG=C and the sealed thread variables; Python -I -B; no inherited array-API or model settings

host.blas: Accelerate; one thread requested by environment, not independently introspected

dependency_verification: NOT RUN; on release verify sealed metadata/RECORD/config files and RECORD-hashed runtime .py/.so/.dylib files excluding tests/test/benchmarks; do not read dependency test datasets; system Accelerate/OS is version-pinned, not whole-OS hashed; unhashed bytecode is outside this accidental-change guard
scientific_calibration: OPEN; tolerances/outer N/domain/scientific error budgets/selection and fresh-validation streams remain UNCHOSEN
